# clearml_user_group (Data Source)

Looks up one ClearML Enterprise user group by exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "clearml_user_group" "ml_engineers" {
  name = "ML Engineers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `assignable` (Boolean)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `system` (Boolean)
- `user_ids` (Set of String)
